title.narrative: Differentiated HIV Services for Key Populations in Malaysia

description.narrative: Malaysia - HIV - Malaysian AIDS Council - MAC. This program has the following goals: To support the DHSKP program domestic funding with a view adoption as the national mechanism for delivery of HIV services among KP. To strengthen the capacity of civil society organistions and community-based organisations in HIV response towards achieving the 95-95-95 ending AIDS targets by 2030.. The objectives of this program are: To increase outreach coverage of MSM through physical outreach activities by 70000 clients (32% of the PSE) and 145000 (66% of the PSE) through online contacts.. To increase outreach coverage of SW through physical outreach activities by 8300 clients (38% of the PSE) and 8300 (38% of the PSE) through online contacts.. To increase outreach coverage of TG through physical outreach activities by 5600 clients (38% of the PSE) and 16800 (113% of the TGSW PSE, considering to also cover non-SW TG) through online contacts.. To increase the testing uptake to 95% of the total reached KPs over the grant period.. To increase the ART initiation by 90% of the total case detected within the grant period.
